local: `lake build` of the added modules with Lean v4.34.1 (the `atk-kernel` toolchain) and `#print axioms` for each theorem. All depend only on `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound` (a few on a subset of them); the ones whose closure needs the whole Mathlib (`FracoesMalhaZeros`, `FracoesFermionsRH`, `BDPisoExato`, `BDMonoide`) were certified by the CI runs above. None uses `sorry`, `admit`, `native_decide` or a declared `axiom`.
tabela: `atk-kernel/ATK/ZeroClasses/PontesRH.lean`

Six proposed "bridges" to RH. Each one turns out to be a theorem, equivalent to RH, or ill-posed: `c ≤ ½` is RH, the induction step `RHAte T → RHAte (T + δ)` is RH, and Hilbert–Pólya (eigenvalue form) implies RH.
`atk-kernel/ATK/ZeroClasses/PontesRHAbscissa.lean`
The same `c` as the abscissa of `Σ μ(n)n^{−s}`.
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesChi.lean`
`χ = 1/p + 1/q + 1/r − 1`: trichotomy, the gap `1/42` at `(2,3,7)`, orders of the polyhedral groups, Hurwitz's bound `84(g − 1)`, Euler `V − E + F = 2`, Beal exponents and `χ`.
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesBernoulli.lean`
`ζ(−1) = −1/12`, `ζ(−3) = 1/120`, `ζ(−5)`, `ζ(−7)`, `ζ(−9)` from Bernoulli numbers; von Staudt–Clausen for small indices.
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesGama.lean`
Continued fractions with a rational tail for the ordinates of zeros of `ζ`, from rational balls taken as hypotheses.
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesEscala.lean`
Scaling law `∫‖k^a f(k·)‖^q = k^{aq−d}∫‖f‖^q`; criticality of Navier–Stokes and Yang–Mills.
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesSAT.lean`
The `7/8` clause average for 3-SAT and the binomial identity behind Schöning's walk.
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesGamaZeros.lean`
The continued fractions above for three certified zeros.
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesParRecorde.lean`

The closest pair of zeros in the certified data (12 363 187 982 787/788), from its two Arb balls taken as hypotheses: continued fractions of both fractional parts with a rational tail, the simplest fraction in each ball (minimal by Farey neighbours), the gap and `−Δγ²/2` in exact rationals, and `3/2000 < s < 1/600 < 1/400 < s` of the previous record pair.
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesSATMedia.lean`
Every 3-CNF formula with distinct variables per clause: the average number of satisfied clauses is exactly `7m/8`, and some assignment satisfies at least `7m/8` (Johnson).
`atk-kernel/ATK/OSLacuna.lean`, `OSTransferencia.lean`, `OSProcesso.lean`, `OSSimetria.lean`, `OSExemplo.lean`

Osterwalder–Schrader reconstruction in time: Hilbert space from a reflection-positive stationary measure, transfer matrix `e^{−tH}`, spectral gap from exponential clustering, symmetries as isometries, an example in `ℂ²` where the bound is attained. Published before as branch-only theorems (`branches/M-Core/atk_rh-rho-independent/`); now in the default branch.
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesMalha.lean`

A mesh of 16 directions `s = c + γ₁e^{ikπ/8}` around even centres: translation and mirror laws (`|ζ|` equal on conjugate directions), rings with `c ≥ 16` free of zeros with `|ζ − 1|≤ 2^{2−σ}(π²/6 − 1)` (centre 600 270: `≤ 2^{−600 253}`), the shift operator `ζ(−1−s)ζ(s)4π² = −(s+1)sζ(s+2)ζ(1−s)`, and the minimum of `|ζ(−2m−δ)|` at `m = 3` for `δ ∈ [0.13, 0.14]`.
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesMalhaZeros.lean`
With the certified first zero `γ₁`: on the 180° axis the ring of centre 8 has the smallest `|ζ|` among even centres `≤ 12`.
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesLinearizacao.lean`
Exact law near the trivial zeros: `|ζ(−2m−δ)|= 2|sin(πδ/2)|·K_m(δ)` with `K_m(δ) = (2π)^{−(2m+1+δ)}Γ(2m+1+δ)|ζ(2m+1+δ)|`, and `2δK_m ≤|ζ(−2m−δ)|≤ πδK_m` for `0 < δ < 1`.
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesPrimons.lean`

The prime gas (modes `n` with energy `log n`) as Osterwalder–Schrader data: mass gap exactly `log 2` (bound from the OS reconstruction, attained by `n = 2`) and `ζ(σ) = Tr e^{−σH}` as a limit of partial traces.
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesFermions.lean`

The fermionic prime gas: Witten index `Σ_{d∣n} μ(d) = [n = 1]`, `Σ μ(n)n^{−s} = 1/ζ(s)` for `Re s > 1`, and for every `θ`: `ζ ≠ 0` on `Re s > θ` ⟺ `1/ζ` has a holomorphic continuation to `Re s > θ` (removable singularity at `s = 1`; identity principle on the upper half-strip, `ζ(s̄) = conj ζ(s)`).
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesFermionsRH.lean`
RH ⟺ `1/ζ = Σ μ(n)n^{−s}` continues holomorphically to `Re s > ½`; the zero-free abscissa `c` equals the holomorphy abscissa of `1/ζ`. Equivalences only: RH stays open.
`atk-kernel/ATK/FracoesZerosTriviais.lean`
The trivial zeros are simple: `‖ζ′(−2m)‖ = (2m)!·|ζ(2m+1)|/(2(2π)^{2m}) ≠ 0` for `m ≥ 1` (limit `δ → 0⁺` of the exact law of `FracoesLinearizacao`), e.g. `|ζ′(−2)|= ζ(3)/(4π²)`.
`atk-kernel/ATK/ZeroClasses/BDPisoExato.lean`

Báez-Duarte weighted distance (round 109, proposal R105): the exact ceiling `TaxaDN σ κ ⟹ κ ≤ 2(σ − Θ)`, so `κ(σ) = 2(σ − Θ)` exactly, `PisoPonderado` becomes a theorem, and RH ⟺ `TaxaDN σ₀ (2σ₀ − 1)` for one fixed `σ₀ ∈ (½, 1)`. Proof via a smoothed Mertens function and its Mellin transform `K(s)/ζ(s)`.
`atk-kernel/ATK/ZeroClasses/BDMonoide.lean`

The same rate on a monoid of `L`-functions (round 110, proposal R110): ceiling `TaxaDNF σ κ ⟹ L ≠ 0` on `Re s > σ − κ/2`, and the join: one rate of the product certifies the zero-free region of every factor (`ζ·L_χ` under a named good-line hypothesis for `L(s, χ)`). Decides neither RH nor GRH.
